title: Mixed Doubles Drama
style: cinematic dub pop duet, 100 BPM, male and female lead vocals, warm sub bass, off-beat skanks, tape echo, conversational verses, anthem chorus, playful chemistry
lyrics:
[Intro — male]
You take the middle
[female]
No YOU take the middle

[Verse 1 — male]
She said poach, but I didn't poach
Now she's giving me the silent coach
I crossed her line, she crossed her arms
We lost the point and we lost our charms

[Verse 2 — female]
He called mine, I called yours
We both stood still like opening doors
The ball just rolled between our feet
Mixed doubles drama on a Tuesday street

[Chorus — both]
Mixed doubles drama, mixed doubles love
Argue at the baseline, hug at the glove
Mixed doubles drama, mixed doubles fight
Won eleven to nine and we're cool tonight

[Verse 3 — male]
I said sorry with my paddle up
She said sorry with a coffee cup
[female]
I said cover your line, baby, watch your zone
[male]
I said you got it, then I left her alone

[Chorus — both]
Mixed doubles drama, mixed doubles love
Argue at the baseline, hug at the glove
Mixed doubles drama, mixed doubles fight
Won eleven to nine and we're cool tonight

[Bridge — spoken duet]
[male] You good?
[female] I'm good.
[male] You sure?
[female] I'm sure.
[male] Switch on two.
[female] On two.

[Outro — both, harmonised]
Mixed doubles drama, mixed doubles love
